# Jimmy Essex

## Overview

Jimmy Essex (born 1989) is an English actor and musician recognized primarily for his work in television, most notably his portrayal of Adam Donovan in the Channel 4 soap opera *Hollyoaks*. Active in the entertainment industry since the early 2010s, Essex has also built a career as a singer-songwriter, known for his soulful pop releases and live performances. He has spoken publicly about LGBT representation in entertainment and has been involved in advocacy for mental health awareness.

## Early Life and Education

Jimmy Essex was born in 1989 in London, England. While detailed information regarding his early life and family is limited in publicly available sources, Essex began pursuing performance interests from a young age. He has stated in interviews that he trained in the performing arts in London before embarking on his professional career. The specifics of his educational background, such as institutions attended or qualifications received, have not been widely disclosed in public sources .

## Acting Career

### Early Work

Before achieving wider recognition, Essex performed in various stage productions. His early career involved appearances in short films and television pilots, which helped him develop his craft and gain industry experience .

### Breakthrough on *Hollyoaks*

Essex gained national attention in 2016 when he was cast as Adam Donovan in *Hollyoaks*, a British soap opera broadcast on Channel 4. During his tenure on the program, Essex's character was involved in several major storylines, including topics related to mental health and family relationships. His portrayal was well received by both critics and audiences, leading to substantial media coverage. Essex remained with *Hollyoaks* for multiple seasons and participated in some of the show’s most significant narrative arcs before his exit, which itself received coverage in entertainment press .

### Additional Roles

In addition to his television work, Essex continued to be involved in theatrical projects and music-related entertainment. While most of his mainstream exposure derives from *Hollyoaks*, his portfolio includes smaller acting projects and guest appearances, as listed on entertainment databases .

## Music Career

### Releases and Style

Parallel to his acting work, Essex has established himself as a singer-songwriter. He has released multiple singles and cover tracks, which are distributed on streaming platforms such as Spotify and Apple Music. His music blends soulful and pop influences, often highlighting themes of love and self-discovery .

### Performances and Recognition

Essex has performed live at various UK venues and music events, which has helped him build a presence as a musician alongside his television career. Media interviews, such as those for Attitude Magazine, have covered his approach to music, his independent releases, and his perspective as an LGBT artist in the entertainment industry . His music and performance work has been supported by digital releases and regular engagement with fans through social media channels .

## Public Advocacy and Personal Life

### LGBT Representation and Mental Health Advocacy

Essex is openly gay and has spoken openly about his experiences in the entertainment industry as a member of the LGBT community. He has used his platform to discuss the importance of representation on and off-screen, specifically in terms of positive portrayals of LGBT characters in British television . Additionally, he has been an advocate for mental health awareness, both in relation to his *Hollyoaks* storylines and through personal interviews and public statements .

### Charity and Public Involvement

Essex has participated in charity events and fundraising activities, particularly those connected with mental health organizations and LGBT causes. Information about his advocacy and personal projects is often shared via his official social media accounts .

Apart from his advocacy work and entertainment career, Essex maintains a relatively private personal life. Public sources confirm his sexual orientation and activism, but do not elaborate extensively on other aspects of his private affairs. There are no widely reported controversies or legal issues associated with Essex as of 2024 .

- Significant national recognition was achieved through Essex's *Hollyoaks* role, bringing him visibility in the UK entertainment industry .
- His departure from *Hollyoaks* in the late 2010s was covered by entertainment media and involved reflection on his contributions to the show's storylines .
- Essex has been featured and interviewed by leading entertainment and LGBT publications, addressing both his career and wider societal issues .
- He has not received major industry awards or nominations, but his participation in impactful storylines and advocacy efforts has been highlighted by various media outlets .
- There are no recorded public controversies involving Essex according to available sources .

[_Big Brother_](https://www.digitalspy.com/big-brother/)'s Battle of the Lewises came to an end last night, as [Kenaley's least favourite housemate](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/big-brother/news/a867193/big-brother-kenaley-vs-lewis-g-legendary-smackdown/), Lewis Gregory, was evicted.

Now that he is out of the house, we had to ask him about one of the biggest stories of the week: 'mince-gate'.

What to Read Next
-----------------

The (now former) housemate [infamously flipped his lid](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/big-brother/news/a866877/big-brothers-lewis-gregory-storms-off-in-biggest-housemate-tantrum-yet/) after Zoe Jones threw out some food he had been preparing.

![Image 1: Big Brother, Day 8/9 – Lewis G](https://hips.hearstapps.com/vidthumb/5ca73d24-c8ef-4037-a44b-9732c94b84b3/thumb_1920x1080_00001_1537781135_55911.jpg?crop=1xw:1xh;center,top)

Speaking to **Digital Spy** exclusively after his exit from the house, Lewis explained what was going through his head at the time, and what he feels about his outburst looking back.

"This is what happened," he said. "I'm pissed, and every night I get pissed in there, I come in and I just want to make some food before bed.

"\[This time\] I had made a beautiful salad as well, but no-one touched it so I'm so excited for this mince and salad that I'm about to have \[...\] I'm cooking the mince, and then Zoe and Kenaley come up and grab the pan and plate of salad and start dashing it in the bin out of nowhere.

"I'm taking it as, 'What the f\*\*k is going on right now?!' Because I heard them saying it's contaminated, but I didn't know Big Brother told them this. I thought they were doing this on a personal \[level\] ...

"I flipped out on the house pretty much because I took it real personal. But I went straight into the Diary Room after Akeem told me \[what happened\] and said I'm really sorry because I took it personally."

![Image 2: Big Brother live eviction 9/28/18: Lewis Gregory](https://hips.hearstapps.com/digitalspyuk.cdnds.net/18/39/1538173645-bb-lewisg7.jpg?resize=980:*)[![Image 3: pinterest](https://www.digitalspy.com/_assets/design-tokens/fre/static/icons/social/pinterest.e8cf655.svg?primary=%2523ffffff)](https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/reality-tv/a867296/big-brother-lewis-gregory-true-story-behind-mincegate/&description=&media=https://hips.hearstapps.com/digitalspyuk.cdnds.net/18/39/1538173645-bb-lewisg7.jpg?resize=1600:*)

Channel 5

He added: "If I would have known or heard that Big Brother said to throw it away, my reaction would have been, 'Oh f\*\*k', but I would have left it there, but I started dishing out my personal \[feelings\] against them.

"It was a little bit of a misunderstanding, but it _was_ a shame that I lost my mince."

Lewis G also told us that he [doesn't believe that he bullied Lewis F](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/big-brother/news/a867294/big-brother-2018-lewis-gregory-denies-bullying-lewis-f/) while in the house.

**_Big Brother_ continues on Sunday (September 30) at 10pm on Channel 5.**

![Image 4: Headshot of Joe Anderton](https://hips.hearstapps.com/rover/profile_photos/6bf117e6-90c2-44bc-a2bb-92355b4636ba_1550228669.file?fill=1:1&resize=120:*)

Joe Anderton is a freelance news writer at **Digital Spy**, having worked there since 2016. In his time, he's covered a host of live events and interviewed celebrities big and small. A big fan of [TV](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/) and [movies](https://www.digitalspy.com/movies/) both mainstream and obscure, Joe also enjoys video games and in particular PlayStation. Joe currently does not use Twitter, but he only ever used it to tell people to watch the film _Help! I'm a Fish_.

![Image 5: Headshot of Justin Harp](https://hips.hearstapps.com/rover/profile_photos/d637ad40-289f-4098-8e5e-342f7900eabf_1550228737.file?fill=1:1&resize=120:*)

Justin is a freelance entertainment journalist and writer. He first joined **Digital Spy** as a freelance entertainment reporter in 2010 and also worked as a sub-editor for the brand, serving as Night News Editor from 2016 to 2024. Over more than a decade, Justin has covered numerous major entertainment events from the US and has interviewed a wide-ranging group of public figures, from comedian Steve Coogan to icons from the _Star Trek_ universe, cast members from the Marvel Cinematic Universe and reality stars from numerous _Real Housewives_ cities and the _Below Deck_ franchise. Justin has also been on the ground to cover major pop culture events like the Star Wars Celebration and the D23 Expo. He's written for titles across the Hearst network, plus the likes of [_CBR_](https://www.cbr.com/author/justin-harp/) and [_Us Weekly_](https://www.usmagazine.com/author/jharp/).

**“I’m An Actor”**

“I’m An Actor” is a new online documentary series exploring the lives of five female actors. They want to follow the highs and lows, as well as find out what it means to be a “successful” actor today.

#### Get Cast Today

Gain access to the best platform for performers and build your career on Backstage.

[Join Now](https://www.backstage.com/subscribe/?next_url=https://www.backstage.com/uk/magazine/article/uk-casting-female-actors-wanted-subjects-documentary-actor-1806/)

Created by Maria Webb and Harry Knight, who describe themselves as “passionate individuals who want to advocate and support actors,” the project is filming a pilot to be used for a crowdfunding campaign. Eventually, the documentary team hopes to follow five actors over a year. If you’re ready to answer questions on your experience with acting, how it affects your personal life, and help the team explore what being an actor means, then this is project could be for you.

They’re looking for individuals who can commit about one day a month for a year, starting with the pilot. Availability is something you can discuss with the team throughout pre-production.

Actors will be paid £60 per day for involvement, but the team hopes to raise enough money to pay each actor £120 a day in future stages. Shooting times may vary but will never exceed eight hours. The documentary aims to shoot across the country and begin filming in May.

Check out [the casting notice](https://www.backstage.com/casting/im-an-actor-213018/), make sure to read the instructions for self-taping carefully, and apply before April 11.
